ideas.title: Investigating Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the allegations of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota and the impact of the Trump administration's decision to freeze funding.
questions: What are the specific allegations of fraud in Minnesota?
How will the freeze on Medicaid funding affect vulnerable populations?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and highlight the need for increased oversight and accountability in the Medicaid program.
